verdict.rationale: treg runs a hosted MCP endpoint at https://treg.to/mcp, and a documented Claude connector authenticates via OAuth with PKCE, so no token or provider key needs to be pasted in. Through that endpoint the client reaches thousands of catalogued downstream provider endpoints, with credentials injected server-side, so the user deploys no infrastructure; the GitHub plugin also installs with no token and no configuration. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent verification that the /mcp endpoint works from an MCP client (the probe only confirms the documentation exists), and setup docs for MCP clients other than Claude.
